_: What this surface still owes the design system, per hanzo-design-lint rule. It may only SHRINK — a fix deletes its own exemption in the same commit, and a violation written today fails the build. `pnpm lint:design` is the gate; @hanzo/design's LLM.md documents the four layers and every rule.
_zero: raw-z-index, local-token-table, second-publisher, shell-owned-chrome, raw-font-size, icon-set and wrong-package are absent, which means ZERO. The stacking ladder is whole: .hz-dock is --z-sticky, the appearance dock --z-dropdown, the calculator's sticky table head --z-raised. local-token-table is why the 244-line gui.config.ts is gone; shell-owned-chrome is real rather than lucky — home/shell.tsx composes @hanzogui/shell's HanzoHeader and HanzoFooter rather than drawing its own.
_backlog: raw-color's 209 is mostly values a token cannot hold: 139 are third-party marks and brand hexes (automations, ProviderMark, AccuracyCostScatter, contact) plus the /brand palette specimen, whose literal IS its content; 20 are the calculator's own two-theme `ts-` palette; and 12 are the linter reading `{`/`}` in a code sample as three-digit hex. The rest is the Tailwind conversion and shrinks as routes move to gui props. inline-style is 21 hero glows carrying hue with no rung to name it. all-caps is copy.
_unresolved: The 12 are names this linter cannot see rather than names nothing declares: it resolves a var() against @hanzo/design's tokens or a declaration in the SAME file. Five are Tailwind's own --tw-gradient-stops, two are @hanzo/composer knobs in a dependency stylesheet, three are the Next font vars next/font mints at build time, and two are this site's own --hz-header and --page-gutter, declared in globals.css and read from a component.
_fonts: redeclared-token is the three font names in globals.css, and it stays 3. next/font mints a per-build family and exposes it as --font-geist; design declares --font-sans by face NAME. Binding one to the other means writing design's name — a name of our own is a name nothing reads.
